title: Induced EMF
description: Essential: The student must state that the induced electromotive force is E = Blv_0, based on motional EMF immediately after contact.

title: Circuit Equivalent Resistance
description: Important: The student must correctly combine the five wire resistances (r each) to find the total circuit resistance of 2r.

title: Initial Current
description: Essential: The student must apply Ohm's law to find the initial current I_0 = (Blv_0) / (2r).

title: Ampere Force at Steady State
description: Important: The student must equate the magnetic damping force (B²l²v/2r) on the sliding wire to the lunar weight (m₁g/6) of the cabin for steady motion.

title: Steady Velocity (No Capacitor)
description: Essential: The student must solve the force balance to find the steady cabin velocity v = (m₁gr) / (3B²l²).

title: Steady Velocity (With Capacitor)
description: Important: The student must reason that at constant speed, the capacitor does not affect current, so v' = v.

title: Capacitor Charge
description: Essential: The student must calculate the capacitor voltage from the circuit and use q = CU_C to find q = (m₁grC) / (6Bl).

title: Sign or Direction Error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign convention for induced EMF or current direction without justification.

title: Resistor Network Mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly combines the wire resistances, e.g., treating them all in series or parallel wrongly.

title: Force Balance Omission
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student fails to set the magnetic force equal to the cabin's weight (m₁g/6) for the steady-state condition.
